# Origin of the test `.chart` files

All `.chart` files in this folder are **100% synthetic**, with no
connection to a real song:

- `sample-song.chart` — hand-written, constant BPM, used in the most
  basic tick→seconds conversion test.
- `synthetic-complex.chart` — generated by
  [`scripts/generate-test-chart.ts`](../../scripts/generate-test-chart.ts)
  (`npm run generate-test-chart`). Covers what the integration tests
  need from a "complex" chart: several different BPM sections, chords,
  sustains and an open note — without depending on any external file.

## History

Until 2026-07-20 this folder also had `real-sample-slipknot.chart` and
`real-sample-doom.chart`, downloaded from a third-party repository
(`AsLogd/chart2json`, with no explicit license) purely as timing text
(no audio). During a security/cleanup pass before the first push to
GitHub, it became clear that publishing the repository would make
those files effectively redistributed, so they were replaced with the
`synthetic-complex.chart` generated above — no test depended on
specific values from that real chart, only on structural properties
(several BPM changes, at least one chord, at least one sustain long
enough), which the synthetic one also covers.
